summary: Set within the highly sought after West Park residential area, this attractive four bedroom detached home offers spacious and versatile accommodation ideal for modern family living. Positioned on a quiet, established street, the property benefits from a private driveway and garage.
description:
LOUNGE The lounge is a bright and inviting reception space, enhanced by contemporary ceiling spotlights that create a clean, modern feel throughout. A feature bay window to the front elevation floods the room with natural light and provides an attractive focal point, while an additional side window further enhances the sense of space and openness.

WC Conveniently located off the entrance hall, the downstairs WC is fitted with a modern two piece suite comprising a low level WC and wash hand basin. Finished in a clean, neutral style, it offers practicality for everyday family living and visiting guests.

KITCHEN/DINER The stylish kitchen/diner forms the heart of the home and is designed for modern family living and entertaining. Featuring contemporary bi-fold doors opening directly onto the rear garden, the space is filled with natural light and creates a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. At the centre is a generous island unit incorporating a gas hob with integrated extractor fan, providing a sociable cooking and preparation space. The kitchen is further enhanced by a range of fitted units and worktops, offering ample storage and functionality. To the rear, there is a fitted fridge freezer, along with a built-in electric oven, completing a well equipped and practical cooking area. The dining space can comfortably accommodates a family sized table, making it ideal for both everyday meals and entertaining guests in a bright, open plan setting.

MASTER BEDROOM WITH ENSUITE The generously sized master bedroom provides a calm and comfortable retreat, offering ample space for a large bed and additional bedroom furnishings. The room benefits from a contemporary en-suite shower room, fitted with a large walk in shower enclosure, low level WC and wash hand basin. A heated towel warmer adds a touch of comfort and practicality.

BEDROOM The second bedroom is a well proportioned double room, offering an excellent amount of space for a variety of furniture arrangements.

BEDROOM The third bedroom is another well-sized double room, offering flexible accommodation to suit a range of needs.

BEDROOM The fourth bedroom is a well proportioned single room, ideal as a child's bedroom, nursery, home office or guest accommodation.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a modern suite comprising a panelled bath, separate shower cubicle, low-level WC, and wash hand basin.

EXTERNALLY The property benefits from gardens to both the front and rear, offering attractive outdoor space for relaxation and family enjoyment. A single garage is also included, providing excellent storage or secure parking. The garage is particularly convenient, with the added advantage of an internal access door leading directly from the hallway.
